source.citation: Shahbazi, Menard, Sohn, Theau (2019), Unmanned aerial image dataset: Ready for 3D reconstruction. Data in Brief 25, 103962. DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103962

processing.method: Parsed source GCP/check point rows and transformed them into Case Study B scene coordinates using the sampled TLS preview transform.

sceneTransform.note: GCP rows are centered and lifted with the same transform as the sampled TLS preview so the two real layers line up in Case Study B.

reviewStatus.notes: This layer is a normalized preview of the published control/check point table. It is aligned to the current Shahbazi TLS preview in scene space; final CRS/orientation review is still required before GIS-grade use.
